sentences.en: Many tons of waste go into the landfill each month.
sentences.zh: 每个月都有成吨的废物被填埋。

sentences.en: Waste is deposited in a landfill in the long term.
sentences.zh: 废料会在垃圾填埋场长期存放。

sentences.en: We have made several failed attempts at foresting the local landfill.
sentences.zh: 我们已经多次尝试在当地的垃圾填埋场上植树，但都失败了。
